I swapped Triceps Pushdown for Low-to-High Cable Fly in today's workout only. The fly keeps your elbows mostly still, so it loads the chest without much triceps or elbow stress. 💪 I skipped dips and overhead extensions because both put a lot of load through the elbow.

Keep the weight light and stay pain-free. If the elbow hurts during your presses, drop the load or stop. If the pain is sharp or doesn't go away, see a professional.
